findings.claim: The cognition shell is a timer machine with no decision and no commit: nothing selects a behavior, no utility/hysteresis exists, drives are read only by the emergency-vice reducer, and a finished dwell emits no WorldEffect, so there is no NPC behaviour yet that could be legible evidence.

findings.bites_when: Change 03/06 content starts: the first Tier-1 schemer needs a reason to walk anywhere, and the first inference trail needs an act to attribute.
findings.disconfirm: Grepped src for drives/utility/hysteresis/behaviors: drives only appear in Coordinator spawn, Reducer compound_emergency_vices, legacy inheritance and RenderFrameBuilder; BehaviorModule has only id/label/dependencyIds/timers/requiresExternalTrigger. The dwell->cooldown transition pushes a phase change and no effect. A utility layer could live in an unread file, but no registry or coordinator code consumes behaviors.
findings.recommendation: Before more cognition schema, define BehaviorModule as {preconditions, considerations (drive/regard/pillar inputs), commit: WorldEffect[], actRecord} and a selection step with an explicit stickiness bonus for the current behavior (the hysteresis), then ship two behaviors for the yard walker. Nothing is observable until a commit exists.
findings.ignore_cost: The 'utility AI with hysteresis' described in the notes stays a promise, and every later system (Regard, motives, rivals) has no place to hook into NPC action.

findings.claim: There is no Act/Intent record connecting what an NPC does, why, and who could perceive it; stimuli carry a free topic string and a source id, and the six romantic-motive discovery channels each presuppose a shared intent object that does not exist, so P4 inference trails have nothing to be made of.

findings.bites_when: Change 06a (motives, 6 channels) and 06b (persecution rumor chain) are proposed, and when the first inference-trail content for S1-R2 is authored.
findings.disconfirm: Looked for any Act/Intent/Plan/Goal type in src/domain: none. Telemetry reasoning is developer-facing and, per S0, the browser does not even feed the NDJSON pipeline, so it cannot double as player-facing evidence. Channel 1 could be implemented ad hoc per motive, but then the other five channels each invent their own evidence type.
findings.recommendation: Add one domain primitive, Act {actorId, verb, objectRef, motiveTag (drive/regard/pillar that won), spaceId, watch, perceptibility (visible/audible/traceable)}, written by every behavior commit. Everything the player can perceive (bubble line, ambient line, door sound, missing item, courier letter) is a rendering of an Act to an observer, and the notebook entries cite Act ids. Motive channels become different observers of the same Act.
findings.ignore_cost: Inference trails get built as per-thread scripted events, which is exactly the authored-puzzle cost the sim was meant to avoid, and tells cannot be generated or tested uniformly.

findings.claim: No model of what an NPC knows exists anywhere; the only stand-in is Regard.exposure, a scalar, so the generation pipeline's 'grounded strictly in NPC epistemic memory' and the player notebook both lack ground truth and provenance.

findings.recommendation: Adopt a minimal shared model now (see unconsidered route 1): Fact (ground truth, owned by the world), Claim (a proposition, may be false), Belief {holder, claimId, confidence, source: witnessed|told|inferred|forged, sourceId, learnedWatch, hops}. Player notebook = the Belief table with holder=player; NPC speech generation reads Beliefs of the speaker only; Regard.exposure becomes a derived summary, not the store.

findings.claim: Remote actors have three disjoint evidence channels (Wider World Overview, correspondence queue, a single global discoveryLayer scalar) but no common Report primitive and no rival agenda, so the owner's rule 'aware of the interaction at some point' cannot be checked or tested.

findings.claim: The anti-thundering-herd rule makes the world player-gated by construction: chains stop at 2 hops until a 'player or macro-world beat', and macro beats only come from watches the player spends, so autonomous gossip and NPC-to-NPC consequence cannot propagate while the player talks or explores (reading costs no watch).

findings.disconfirm: The 1-per-pulse cap itself is harmless: pulseCognitiveScheduler runs every frame, so it admits about 60 promotions per second, not a bottleneck. Nothing dispatches enqueue_npc_stimulus today, so inertness is a design prediction, not an observed bug.
findings.recommendation: Split two things the notes merge: embodied reactive cascades (keep the hop cap, they are what stampedes) and information diffusion (rumors, news), which should be closed-form per watch over the Regard/Belief graph with no per-NPC deliberation. Let the Storyteller release an off-screen beat on wall-clock time too, not only on watch spend, so something is always in motion.
findings.ignore_cost: A world that waits for the player to act, which the owner's 'living world' premise and every rival/romance design assumes it is not.

findings.claim: A per-watch presence table has a clean seam (materialize at room entry using the existing off_stage_region space kind) but three shipped details fight it: every character spawns at its start waypoint at construction, cognition timers live on the room-seconds clock while presence changes on the watch clock, and pending stimuli have no defined fate across a watch jump.
findings.bites_when: 05b lands watches and the first Committed Time-Spend action advances the clock with NPCs mid-dwell or with queued stimuli.
findings.disconfirm: KinematicsEngine already skips off_stage_region bodies from collision (SpatialHashGrid 85-95), so parking people off-stage is supported. Could not find a schedule or time-of-day field anywhere, so the table is wholly additive. Nothing shipped blocks it.
findings.recommendation: Make presence a pure function (entity, watch, seed) -> {spaceId, waypointId, activityAct}, applied by a materialize step when the player enters a space or a watch is spent; on a watch jump, resolve in-flight phases to idle, drop non-persistent stimuli, and run the closed-form catch-up that emits Acts (S2A-02) for what happened while away. Start entities in off_stage_region, not at start waypoints.
findings.ignore_cost: People pop in and out with no reason (immersion break) or keep stale mid-action state across a four-hour skip.

findings.claim: The player notebook as specified (known, suspected, partial, omitted) mixes how sure the player is with what the world holds; 'complete omissions' cannot be shown without leaking that the unknown exists, and the six hidden-motive channels have no shared evidence type to feed any category.

unconsidered_routes.title: Fact/Claim/Belief triple as one shared store
unconsidered_routes.proposal: World owns Facts (ground truth). Anything said, written or posted is a Claim pointing at a Fact or marked false. Each holder (NPC or player) has Beliefs {claimId, confidence, source kind, source id, learnedWatch, hops}. Gossip is Belief copy with decay along Regard edges per watch. The notebook is the player's Belief view; NPC lines are generated from the speaker's Beliefs only.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Dwarf Fortress thoughts/rumor logs, Shadows of Doubt's case board, CK3 secrets/hooks
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces Regard.exposure as the only knowledge carrier; gives P2 generation and S1-R5 a single ground truth.

unconsidered_routes.title: Act record with observers, not scripted trails
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Every committed behavior writes an Act with motive tag and perceptibility. Observers (player, NPC witnesses by room/earshot, remote channels) each receive a rendering. Passion-style tags (Levine's Narrative Lego) such as 'protects kin' or 'hates debt' are the same data as drives/pillars and are what make the Act attributable.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Ken Levine 'Narrative Lego' passions; Hitman NPC witness/suspicion states; Watch Dogs Legion trait-driven behaviour
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces authored per-thread inference events with generated, testable evidence.

unconsidered_routes.title: Diffusion as closed-form per watch, embodied reaction as the only cascade
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Rumor and news spread by a per-watch pass over the Belief/Regard graph (SIR-style), never as per-NPC deliberation. Only visible reactions (walk to the door, shout) go through the 2-hop cascade. Autonomy budget per watch comes from the Storyteller.
unconsidered_routes.reference: CK3 secret and rumor spread; Dwarf Fortress thought propagation; RimWorld Storyteller
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Narrows the anti-herd rule to its real job and removes the player-gating from information flow.

unconsidered_routes.title: Evidence coverage test
unconsidered_routes.proposal: A headless eval that rolls an epoch with fast pacing and asserts every Act above a weight threshold produces at least one Report or witnessed trace within N watches, and every notebook omission has a referent.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Obra Dinn's solvability checking; Outer Wilds ship-log rumor graph audits
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Turns the owner's 'be aware at some point' rule into an automated invariant under the existing eval runner.
